# Amateur radio country catalog

`cty.dat` by Jim Reisert AD1C, as distributed by WSJT-X.
Upstream: https://www.country-files.com/
Pinned distribution: https://github.com/WSJTX/wsjtx/tree/11c564e966c860a7f633e70e4704732409ce48d3
Snapshot: 2025-01-27. Retrieved: 2026-10-11. File unmodified.
Permission and copyright notice: LICENSE.txt (permissive MIT-style grant).

Obrii uses the 340 DXCC entities. CTY entries marked `*` (additional WAE
entities) are not separate DXCC filter rows. Exact callsign overrides (`=`)
are supported. Prefix assignment is a best-effort estimate, not proof of
location, nationality, or authorization. Importing a newer CTY file is
available in the country filter without a network request.
